name: Neue Post
beschreibung: The youth hostel "Neue Post" is located in Tirol and offers a central location for exploring the surrounding area. The facilities include multi-bed rooms and functional common rooms. The atmosphere is practical and uncomplicated, without excessive comfort. The accommodation is aimed at budget-conscious travelers such as backpackers and groups. The culinary offering consists of a breakfast buffet and optional dinner. The surrounding area allows for activities such as hiking and skiing in the Alpen.
